features.name: Core Scaffold
features.behavior: Set up the initial project scaffold and baseline directory structure for this repository.
features.verification: Run the project verification command and confirm baseline startup commands succeed.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix static-analysis errors and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Fix failing tests and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: Build/system confirmation
layers.repair: Fix build/runtime integration issues and rerun the layer command.

features.name: Primary Capability
features.behavior: Implement the first end-user or API-facing capability for this project.
features.verification: Run layer checks and confirm the capability works through its primary use path.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix static-analysis issues and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Add or fix tests for the feature and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Fix end-to-end behavior and rerun the layer command.

features.name: Reliability and Guardrails
features.behavior: Add tests, validation, and failure handling for critical flows implemented so far.
features.verification: Run verification layers and confirm failure scenarios are covered by tests.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix static-analysis issues and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Add or fix unit/integration tests and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Fix remaining cross-layer issues and rerun full verification.

features.name: Documentation Alignment
features.behavior: Update user and developer documentation to match implemented behavior and interfaces.
features.verification: Run doc-related checks (if configured) and manually validate critical instructions end-to-end.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix documentation lint/style issues and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Fix documentation examples/tests and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Resolve remaining drift between docs and system behavior, then rerun full verification.

features.name: Release Readiness
features.behavior: Prepare the project for release or handoff with final verification evidence and cleanup.
features.verification: Run clean-state checks and ensure all required handoff artifacts are complete.

layers.label: Layer 1: Static checks
layers.repair: Fix remaining static-analysis issues and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 2: Runtime tests
layers.repair: Fix remaining test failures and rerun the layer command.

layers.label: Layer 3: System confirmation
layers.repair: Resolve cleanup/handoff issues and rerun clean-state checks.

features.name: Optional Enhancements
features.behavior: Track additional improvements that are valuable but not required for baseline release.
features.verification: Define project-specific verification criteria before moving this feature to active.

layers.repair: Fix static-analysis issues and rerun the layer command.
